outcome: The Delivery tab shows the project's six delivery lines from the live overview
acceptance_criteria: `GET /projects/{uuid}/delivery-overview` is requested exactly once when `/projects/{uuid}/delivery` opens — verify: network log on Next 4990 (proxied to Django 8030) shows one request, 200.

Six rows appear in the order release, go-live, hypercare, handover, archive, closure, even when the fixture returns them shuffled — verify: unit test on `deliveryModel.ts` with shuffled lines; page shows 01 to 06 in order.
A started row shows title, reference, state tag and "Updated <date>", and "Open" goes to `/work/{work_id}` — verify: mock 4991 project P-0101, click Open on Release gates, URL is `/work/<id>`.

A not-started row shows NOT STARTED with no reference, no date and no link, and no "0" or "Unknown" placeholder text in those slots — verify: second fixture project (all six `not_started`); page text contains no link in any row.
Every `state` value in the contract maps to the table's tag text; an unlisted value shows UNKNOWN — verify: unit test over all 11 states plus null plus a made-up value.
The page does not show "of 6 done", a DLV file number, gate wording such as "RELEASE READY", or a Tola check or "Next" sentence — verify: page text search on the P-0101 fixture finds none.

With closure not started and `ready_to_prepare: false`, the closure row lists the title (and `finding`) of each held, unknown or unavailable check and nothing from current/closed/recorded checks — verify: component test with a checklist fixture.
With `ready_to_prepare: true`, or when release-register or closure-checklist fails (403, 500, network), no closure reason shows and the six overview rows still show — verify: component test for each.
The closure checklist is not requested when the release row has no `work_id` or when closure has a `work_id` — verify: test asserts no checklist call.
403 and 404 on the overview show the same no-access panel with no project name or server message — verify: open `/projects/<P-0099 id>/delivery` on mock 4991.
A 500 or network failure shows the error panel; "Try again" re-reads once and recovers — verify: component test with a failing then succeeding mock.
A response with the wrong shape (missing key, five lines, duplicated key, unknown key) shows the error state, not a partial list — verify: unit test on the response check.
The page makes no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE and contains no start, edit or assign control — verify: grep `DeliveryTab.tsx`, `useDeliveryOverview.ts` for non-GET calls; none.
Mobile width (390px) shows the six rows stacked without horizontal scroll — verify: browser at 390px on Next 4990.
`src/features/workspace/**` and every path in `delivery/config.json` `protected_paths` have no changes — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main` lists neither.

New tests exist for the model, the hook (race: a late answer for an earlier project is ignored) and the tab states, and `src/api/live-schema.d.ts` is unchanged — verify: `git diff --stat`, test files present.

risk.rationale: Low: a read-only screen on one new endpoint, with no money, identity, migration or sensitive data. It follows the existing line adapter pattern, and the only cross-layer contract is the overview response shape, which the live contract fixes. Surfaces are ui and api. Product acceptance is required because the overview flow and copy change from the mock. It can merge under D-180/D-184 once the build is on F-85.

findings.summary: effect_uncertain maps to the amber "waiting" tone; the spec asks for the "stopped" tone, and caution maps to "person". TagTone has no stopped or caution values, so the builder chose the nearest tone (build.md Notes). The result is that RESULT UNCERTAIN looks like a waiting state. Expected: a distinct tone for an uncertain effect, or a recorded decision that the UI reviewer accepts. Actual: frontend/src/features/projects/deliveryModel.ts STATE_WORDS. Any new tone belongs in the shared Tag component, so confirm with the design engineer first.

visibleTabs inserts Delivery with the hard index `PROJECT_TABS[1]`. Reordering PROJECT_TABS would silently move the tab. Expected: look it up by key, for example `PROJECT_TABS.find((t) => t.key === 'delivery')`. Actual: frontend/src/features/projects/model.ts visibleTabs.

stateWords has a redundant ternary: `line.gate_state === 'not_started' ? 'not_started' : line.gate_state` equals `line.gate_state`, so the expression reads as a rule it does not add. Result is correct. Expected: `line.state ?? line.gate_state`. Actual: frontend/src/features/projects/deliveryModel.ts stateWords.

mock/delivery-overview.mjs started() sets gate_url to the release-register URL for every line. F-113B reads gate_url, so this fixture would send five lines to the wrong gate. Expected: each line's own gate path, or null. Actual: frontend/mock/delivery-overview.mjs:started.

acceptance criteria 10 (403/404 in a browser on 4990) and 14 (390px with no horizontal scroll) are not run (build.md marks them open). The mobile rules in delivery.css place reference and date in column 2 explicitly, while title and tag auto-place, so the 390px result is not clear from the code. Expected: a browser check before merge. Owner: frontend, with the UI/QA check at 390px on 4990.

the closure reason list is keyed by `r.title`. Two checks with the same title would give duplicate React keys. Expected: key by the check key (carry it in HoldReason) or by index. Actual: frontend/src/features/projects/DeliveryTab.tsx, reasons map.

The row layout breaks the approved SCR-43 board (desktop and mobile). Expected: one aligned row with number, title, reference, tag, date and Open, padded inside the panel (the `.delivery__row` grid, `frontend/src/features/projects/delivery.css:3`). Actual, at 1280px and 390px on P-0101: the tag renders at the left edge and overlaps the "Updated <date>" text. "ACTION NEEDED" over "Updated 20 Nov" is unreadable. The reference sits far right on its own line on desktop, and rows touch the panel border. The grid columns and padding seem not to apply, or the Tag's inline-flex width fights the `auto` track. Fix the layout so no cells overlap and rows are padded. Re-check at both widths. Screenshots (no sign-in involved): /private/tmp/claude-501/ux/d-P-0101.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/ux/m-P-0101.png.

The closure reason joins the check title and its finding with only a space ("Handover to Support Support listed 2 gaps."). Add a separator such as an en dash, or put the finding on its own line, so the two read as separate parts (`frontend/src/features/projects/DeliveryTab.tsx`, the `delivery__finding` span).

The 390px row stacks reference, tag and date on separate lines with large gaps (about 90px per row), so six rows take over 1100px. SCR-43-mobile puts reference and date under the title and groups them tightly. Tighten the row gap once UX-1-1 is fixed.

Tag and date overlap in every row at 1440 and 390 (for example "VERIFIEDpdated 25 Mar", "ACTION NEEDED" printed over "Updated 20 Nov"). The Tag is not laid out in its own grid cell, so the text is unreadable. Expected (board): the tag right-aligned, title and reference on the left, nothing overlapping. `frontend/src/features/projects/delivery.css:3` (6-column grid) against `DeliveryTab.tsx:56-69`. Visible in both side-by-side.png files.

At 1440 the reference ("REL-0091") and "Open" are flush against the panel's right border with no inset (the `projects__journeybody` body class appears to override the row padding set at `delivery.css:3`). The board rows have a 16px inset on both sides. Make the row padding show on both edges.

Mobile (390) row structure differs from SCR-43-mobile. The board draws one compact line per row (title left, tag right, about 40px high). The build stacks title, reference, tag, date and Open vertically at about 195px per row, so six rows take about two screens. Put title and tag on one line, with reference and date beneath in small text and Open compact. `delivery.css:13-19`.

Copy and element differences that the spec does not list among the hidden parts: the board's row title is an underlined link to the line (the build has plain text plus a separate "Open"), and the panel head reads "DELIVERY LINES" where the board says "THE SIX DELIVERY LINES, IN ORDER". Restore, or ask the design engineer to list them as exceptions.

No `fidelity-exceptions.json` for F-113, so the tool reports 23 (desktop) and 3 (mobile) board items missing. The spec-hidden ones are: DLV-0052 header and "3 OF 6 DONE" tag, the "PM TUNDE BELLO" tag, the sub-nav strip (Overview, Release, Go-live, ...), the Tola card ("Checked where delivery stands", DONE, Ask Tola), the NEXT card, "Open the handover", and the per-row gate sentences. The design engineer must list them in `fidelity-exceptions.json` before the tool can pass. Also extra: "Setup" nav link, alerts, account menu (shell, not this feature), the "DELIVERY LINES" head and "Checked ..." line.
